definition_used: When a journal/publisher states that no manuscripts will be accepted from one or more authors of the original article. Bans could be for a limited time or indefinitely.
caution: Publishing ban is a post-publication sanction, not a direct indicator of manuscript content or process flaws. It reflects journal policy enforcement, not necessarily a retraction cause.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a journal/publisher-imposed ban on future submissions from authors, which is a post-publication oversight action (publication_policy_or_sanction) involving journal/publisher and author actors. It fits post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight as a transparency/due-process measure, but does not directly indicate issues with research content, authorship, or editorial processes.
